The man is the pub's potman — the old fellow who clears the tables. He is bald on top

He carries a round metal tray flat on his **left** hand. In his **right** hand he has

mouthful of drink left in it. It is not his drink. It is a customer's leftover, and he

He lowers it because he is being watched, and specifically because the one person he

## Analysis of the Bar Scene

In the British comedy film *Windbag the Sailor* (1936), the barman in the ship-themed pub (decorated with nautical beams, lifebuoys, and ship steering wheels) is **Jeremiah Harbottle** (played by character actor **Moore Marriott**).
